summary: The agent loaded the hyperpowers:requesting-code-review skill and sent a reviewer subagent with the template. The reviewer flagged both real defects as Critical: the pagination offset at handlers.js:18 and the unawaited saveOrder at handlers.js:37. It also rejected the merge. But it raised several blocking (Important) findings against code the story says is correct: withRetry (#10, #11), the module-load readFileSync of config.json (#12), and the log-and-rethrow catch in listOrdersHandler (#9). So the precision criteria fail.
reasoning: The workflow ran correctly: the skill was loaded, the Agent tool sent the reviewer, both real defects were reported as Critical with a solid trigger and outcome, and the verdict was 'No'. But the reviewer put blocking Important findings on three items the story says are correct: withRetry (#10, #11), the module-load readFileSync in config.js (#12), and the log-and-rethrow catch in listOrdersHandler (#9). That fails criteria 5, 6, 7 and 10, so the overall verdict is fail.

observations.description: The reviewer over-flags: 13 Important findings, including blocking ones against code that is correct (withRetry, the config readFileSync, the log-and-rethrow catch). This buries the two real defects in noise.

The main agent's summary drops file:line for several Important items that the subagent had cited (e.g. 'size is unbounded', 'No total/hasMore'), so the user sees less evidence than the reviewer produced.
The agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review even though the user asked for superpowers:requesting-code-review. This is allowed, but the agent didn't mention the substitution.
The final message has a long Codex plugin install advertisement and records an 'ungated range' in a sweep ledger. The user didn't ask for either.
On first launch, the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit'. Expected, but worth noting for automation.
The main agent's summary refers to '#7' and '#8', but its condensed Important list has no numbers, so those references are confusing.

criteria.criterion: Invoked requesting-code-review skill and dispatched reviewer via Agent tool
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use entries: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}}, Read code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}; subagent log agent-a662a5f2c9d59f0b8.jsonl exists
Subagent report under '#### Critical (Must Fix)': '1. Off-by-one in the page offset — the first page of orders is unreachable. src/handlers.js:18 — const offset = page * size;'
Under Critical: '2. store.saveOrder is not awaited: creation reports 201 for orders it failed to save, then crashes the process. src/handlers.js:37'
'Ready to merge? No'. The main agent also said 'Verdict: not ready to merge'.

criteria.criterion: No blocking finding against the listed correct items (header)
criteria.evidence: Sub-items 6, 7 and 10 below fail: Important #9, #10, #11 and #12 target code listed as correct.

criteria.criterion: withRetry not flagged as a blocking defect
criteria.evidence: Under Important: '10. withRetry around an in-memory Array.slice is scope creep and actively harmful' and '11. withRetry throws undefined when attempts <= 0. src/util.js:8-18'

criteria.criterion: config.js module-load readFileSync not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Under Important: '12. Externalizing config into config.json is unrequested, unguarded, and unvalidated. src/config.js:7-9 ... A missing or malformed config.json throws a raw ENOENT/SyntaxError at require time.'
parseOrderId was praised under Strengths ('handler correctly returns a 400'). The only other mention is a Minor naming note: 'src/util.js:23 — parseOrderId doesn't parse'.

criteria.criterion: listOrders returning orders.slice not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Important #4 mentions listOrders(0, 1000000) but the defect it names is the unbounded size parameter in the handler (handlers.js:17), not slice. Making listOrders async is only a Minor note (src/store.js:5).

criteria.criterion: listOrdersHandler log-and-rethrow catch not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Under Important: '9. Two incompatible error contracts in one module. src/handlers.js:25-28 logs and rethrows ... listOrdersHandler should catch and return {status: 500...}'

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock / seeded 25-order test fixture not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Important #13 criticizes the weak assertion (length === 10), not the fixture. Strengths say 'The test seeds 25 rows ... right shape'. The CLOCK/seed() comments are under Minor only.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important finding cites file:line and a trigger plus outcome
criteria.evidence: Each of #1–#13 cites a file:line (e.g. handlers.js:16-18, :17, :24, :36, store.js:16, util.js:8-18, config.js:7-9, test/handlers.test.js:21-27). Each also gives an input or state and its outcome (e.g. 'page=-2 returned 10 rows starting at ord_00000005', 'withRetry(fn,{attempts:0}) rejects with undefined'). #5 (no total/hasMore) is the weakest, but it does describe what happens: the client cannot tell end-of-data from overshoot.
